title: Crazy Babe

description.main: Bob Coulter's first book, published by Goliath in 2003, collects more than three hundred colour nudes from his website crazybabe.com, snapshot-style pictures made in New York hotel rooms, apartments and lakesides by a former record producer who took up the camera to feed the site.
description.extended:
Bob Coulter's Crazy Babe, published by Goliath in 2003, is the first book from a former record producer who began photographing nudes to fill his own website, and it collects more than three hundred of those pictures in Goliath's small oblong format.

The photographs are digital snapshots, lit hard and framed close, made in apartments, hotel rooms, city streets and by lakes outside New York. Several were shot at the Chelsea Hotel with guitars and other rock-and-roll props, and Goliath sold the book as stills from a music video, had MTV allowed nudity. The 368 pages carry 345 colour plates with text in English, German, French, Spanish and Italian. The book measures 19 by 14 cm; the same ISBN was later reused for a 2015 softcover reprint.

Coulter started crazybabe.com in 1999, by his own account as a get-rich-quick scheme, and picked up a Nikon Coolpix 990 when the site needed original content. Goliath followed with a second book, Bad Girls Hotel (2005), photographed over a year at the Carlton Arms Hotel on East 25th Street.
description.artist_bio: Bob Coulter worked as an independent record producer before launching the subscription photo site crazybabe.com in 1999 and taking up photography to supply it with original content. Goliath published two books of his work: Crazy Babe (2003) and Bad Girls Hotel (2005).

notes: Shelf: Mollino / Richardson. Text in English, German, French, Spanish and Italian. Same ISBN reused for a 2015 softcover reprint.
